For a select group of talented student entrepreneurs, we are turning the summer internship on its head. In place of an ordinary internship, students selected will receive weekly stipends and compete for additional cash awards as they launch a business. In addition, you’ll have access to mentors, investors, business, and social events. The program will end with a Pitch & Demo Day involving stakeholders from across WNY. Who can apply? Buffalo Student Sandbox is accepting applications from teams led by current undergrad or graduate students and ’14 - ‘16 grads. It is required that your CEO meet these criteria. What if I’m from WNY but attend school elsewhere? If you’re planning to be in town this summer, please apply! What if I’m an international student at a school in WNY? If you’re planning to be in town this summer, please apply! Procedures surrounding tax withholdings for international students will be slightly different, but the program will otherwise be the same. About Us | WNY Incubator Network / WNY Innovation Hot Spot Menu Startup Week About Us Contact Us Incubation Programs Access UB Cultivator Deals & Discounts SBIR / STTR Assistance Tax Incentives News About Us Collaborating to help start ups thrive in WNY Starting a business is never easy, but access to the right tools can make a world of difference. The Western New York Incubator Network is a collaborative effort of incubators and entrepreneurial service providers from New York's Allegany, Cattaraugus, Chautauqua, Erie, and Niagara Counties, working together to turn our region into a hotbed of entrepreneurial activity. We share best practices, networking, mentoring, educational, and financial resources to better assist incubator client companies. We are designated as the WNY Innovation Hot Spot , a NYSTAR program enabling program funding and a unique set of tax incentives for companies in their earliest stages. Our program is managed via the University at Buffalo . Tax Incentives for Incubator Companies | WNY Incubator Network / WNY Innovation Hot Spot Menu Startup Week About Us Contact Us Incubation Programs Access UB Cultivator Deals & Discounts SBIR / STTR Assistance Tax Incentives News Tax Incentives for Incubator Companies In 2013, New York State created the Innovation Hot Spot program to fund operations in business incubators and extend tax incentives to qualified ventures in participating incubators. WIN serves as the Innovation Hot Spot in the WNY economic development region , and can certify companies for eligibility. To be certified, companies must be: Enrolled and in good standing with a WIN incubator In their first five years of operations (or seven years for life sciences ventures) In the formative stages of development (defined as one of the following): Still in the testing/development phase of of the product being produced Has raised less than $1M equity capital Has not yet earned profits from sales Once qualified, a company enters into a five year window of exemption from state corporate income tax and state sales tax on purchases. In that period, partners in the company are also eligible to deduct their income from the incubator company. This window lasts for five years, regardless of company age when entering the program, provided the company remains in good standing as a resident or graduate of its incubator. Is this
START-UP NY was designed as a tax program that incubator companies can ‘graduate’ into.
START-UP NY requires an application and a campus to sponsor the company; the Hot Spot only requires that the company is an incubator client.
IHS benefits are available regardless of physical location, as long as they are an incubator client.

Access UB | WNY Incubator Network / WNY Innovation Hot Spot Menu Startup Week About Us Contact Us Incubation Programs Access UB Cultivator Deals & Discounts SBIR / STTR Assistance Tax Incentives News Get Access to the University at Buffalo The University at Buffalo is both big - the largest and most comprehensive campus in the 64-campus SUNY system - and bright, ranking among the top 2% of American universities as a member of the Association of American Universities. UB's three campuses, 110 degree programs, 30,000 students, and $400M annual research spend combine to create a wealth of opportunities for partnering startups. WIN collaborates with on-campus partners to produce a series of programs that help early stage companies connect with UB faculty, students, and facilities in ways that encourage partnerships and drive economic growth in the region. Programs include: Inclusive Launch: links startup companies with minority and female students for internship opportunities Reverse Pitch: brings startup companies on campus to pitch students on their innovative business models, culture, and career oppportunities Startup Alley: creates a cohesive, well marketed presence of incubator companies at on-campus career fairs WIN regularly connects startups seeking to access UB and professors/student clubs looking to partner with early stage companies. Cultivator | WNY Incubator Network / WNY Innovation Hot Spot Menu Startup Week About Us Contact Us Incubation Programs Access UB Cultivator Deals & Discounts SBIR / STTR Assistance Tax Incentives News UB Cultivator The Cultivator surrounds early stage startup founders in WNY with mentorship and support to build our region's next great companies. Founders are paired with entrepreneurs-in-residence and subject matter experts to help new ventures validate market potential, establish marketing plans, gear up to fundraise, and connect with investors and customers. A two-phased program, the Cultivator engages founders to identity and reach product-market fit through a six month Phase 1, before graduating to Phase 2. In Phase 2, ventures earn $100,000 in startup funding and access to free coworking space. As a WIN program, the Cultivator extends beyond UB and is available to companies in WIN's region of Allegany, Cattaraugus, Chautauqua, Erie, and Niagara Counties. The program does not require a prior affiliaion with UB. You can read more about the Cultivator program here and begin your formal application process here . Pitch Prep | WNY Incubator Network / WNY Innovation Hot Spot Menu Startup Week About Us Contact Us Incubation Programs Access UB Cultivator Deals & Discounts SBIR / STTR Assistance Tax Incentives News Pitch Prep WIN's Pitch Prep series assists incubator companies raise outside capital. Each year, we organize a multi-session course which includes the motivations and preferences of different investor types, how to develop a successful pitch, opportunities to present to & be critiqued by a friendly panel of investors, and coaching on term sheets and valuation. Sessions are held both in person and online and draw upon WIN's network of experienced investors outside of Western New York. When appropriate, the program is deployed in real time to help companies presenting in programs including Bright Buffalo Niagara, 43North, the NYS Business Plan Competition, and for individual meetings with investors. Since 2014, participating companies have since raised more than $20M in outside funding from numerous sources including angels, private equity firms, state and federal programs, institutional, and other investors.
